title: Hy-MT3: More Accurate, Robust and Practical Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2611.27673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hy-MT3 is the third generation of the Hunyuan multilingual translation model family, including \textbf{Hy-MT3-1.8B}, \textbf{Hy-MT3-7B} and \textbf{Hy-MT3-30B-A3B (MoE)}. Compared with Hy-MT2, Hy-MT3 translates \textbf{more accurately, more completely and more faithfully to user constraints}: on real-world scenario data, the share of samples with mistranslations is reduced by \textbf{43\%}, omissions or additions by \textbf{74\%}, and instruction-following errors by \textbf{40\%}, while language coverage is expanded from \textbf{38 to 102} languages. With only 3B activated parameters, \textbf{Hy-MT3-30B-A3B achieves the best overall performance among all evaluated models in non-thinking mode}, including flagship models such as Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi-K3.1-Pro and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and approaches the strongest closed-source thinking models such as GPT-6.1-Sol and Gemini-4-Argon, while surpassing models that consume \textbf{more than 30$\ti

translated_title: Hy-MT3：更准确、更鲁棒且更实用的真实场景多语言翻译模型
translated_abstract: Hy-MT3 是混元多语言翻译模型家族的第三代，包括 Hy-MT3-1.8B、Hy-MT3-7B 和 Hy-MT3-30B-A3B（MoE 架构）。与 Hy-MT2 相比，Hy-MT3 的翻译更准确、更完整、更忠实于用户约束：在真实场景数据上，误译样本比例降低了 43%，漏译或增译问题降低了 74%，指令遵循错误降低了 40%，同时语言覆盖范围从 38 种语言扩展到 102 种。仅需 3B 激活参数，Hy-MT3-30B-A3B 便在非思考模式下取得了所有评测模型中的最佳整体性能，超越了 Qwen3.8-Max、Kimi-K3.1-Pro 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 等旗舰模型，并接近 GPT-6.1-Sol 和 Gemini-4-Argon 等最强的闭源思考模型，同时超越了消耗超过 30 倍资源的模型。
tldr: Hy-MT3 系列通过将误译率降低 43%、漏译增译降低 74%、指令遵循错误降低 40%，并把语言覆盖扩展至 102 种，其仅 3B 激活参数的 MoE 模型在非思考模式下超越了众多旗舰大模型并逼近最强闭源思考模型。
